# arianet_ssh_key (Resource)

An account-wide SSH key, kept by core and served by arianet-api at `/api/v1/ssh-keys`. Use its ID in `arianet_server.ssh_key_ids`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_ssh_key" "me" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the key.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key line, e.g. `file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")`. Changing it replaces the key.

### Optional

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether the key is the account's default key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint.
- `id` (String) SSH key ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_ssh_key.me 15
```
